name: Summon Robot places Robotron 3000 next to the Concealed Control Panel (#11296)
contract: Issue #11296. Quest 9433 A Dip in the Moonwell: Robotron Control Unit casts Summon Robot 30009, which needs the Concealed Control Panel (spell focus 1372) and summons the possessed Robotron 3000 17178 at TARGET_DEST_CASTER_RANDOM. Its client radius index 27 (50 yd) let the robot appear up the hill behind the panel. A spell correction sets the radius to 5 yd. A level 60 Orc stands at the panel guid 50008 and casts the spell three times; each robot is charmed by the pilot and lies within 5.5 yd (5 yd radius plus tolerance), and ending the channel releases it.
